name: Green Room
tagline: Run an am-dram show from auditions to curtain call
about: Green Room is the stage manager's brain for community theatre, school shows and youth productions: audition notices, rehearsal schedules that respect people's evenings, props and costume lists from the script, front-of-house rotas and break-even ticket prices, plus programme and publicity copy.
persona: You are a veteran amateur-theatre producer and stage manager: enthusiastic, ruthlessly organised, kind to nervous first-timers, and fully aware everyone has a day job.

onboarding.title: Places, everyone
onboarding.subtitle: Tell us about your society and the show.

tools.title: Audition pack
tools.subtitle: Notice, pieces and panel checklist

inputs.label: Roles you need
inputs.placeholder: 2 men 40s, 3 women 30–60, one cameo any age

tools.prompt: Prepare auditions on {dates} for: {needs}. Sections: a quote with the audition notice (show, dates, roles with age ranges, what to prepare, commitment expected, contact), a table of audition pieces (Role | Scene or moment | What to look for), a checklist for the panel on the night, and a callout on fair casting and telling people kindly when they didn't get it.

tools.title: Rehearsal schedule
tools.subtitle: Calls that respect people's lives

inputs.label: Rehearsal window
inputs.placeholder: 20 Jan to 12 Mar, Tue and Thu evenings plus 2 Sundays

inputs.label: Known clashes
inputs.placeholder: Dev away 2–9 Feb, under-16s not after 9pm

tools.prompt: Build a rehearsal schedule across {window} for a {acts} show with clashes: {clashes}. Sections: a table (Date | Scenes | Who's called | Focus), bullets on the plan's logic (blocking first, runs later, tech and dress at the end), kv (total rehearsals, run-throughs, tech, dress, get-in), and a callout on never calling people who aren't needed.

tools.title: Props & costume
tools.subtitle: Production lists from the script

inputs.label: Paste a scene or act summary
inputs.placeholder: Act 1: living room, seance, gramophone, tray of martinis, Madame Arcati in a cape…

tools.prompt: From: {script}, build production lists. Sections: a table of props (Item | Scene | Who handles | Source: own, borrow, make or buy | Cost est.), a second table of costume by character (Character | Look | Changes | Notes), a checklist setting list per scene for stage management, and a callout on fire, weapons and food on stage.

tools.title: Front of house
tools.subtitle: Ticket prices, rota and house rules
tools.prompt: {seats} seats across {nights} nights with costs: {costs}. Sections: kv (break-even at three price points, suggested ticket prices, interval bar target), a table front-of-house rota (Night | Box office | Ushers | Bar | Stage door), a checklist for house management (safety announcement, exits, first aid, cash), and a callout on performance rights and licensing to confirm before selling a single ticket.

tools.title: Programme & publicity
tools.subtitle: Director's note, posts and listing

inputs.label: Angle
inputs.placeholder: our 50th anniversary, first youth cast member

tools.prompt: Write publicity with this angle: {angle}. Sections: a quote with a 150-word director's note for the programme, cards for 4 social posts across the run (meta = week · goal), a second quote with a 100-word local press listing, and bullets on programme content order (cast, crew, thanks, next show, sponsors).

disclaimer: Performance rights, licensing, insurance and safeguarding for under-18s are legal requirements that vary by place; confirm them with the rights holder and your venue.
